verdict.rationale: Docs show a run-events polling API (`runs.events()`) that can build a step-by-step action timeline for monitoring/debugging, plus a live-preview URL for human intervention during a run, but there is no evidence of recorded video or screenshot capture for post-hoc replay debugging of failed runs. missing for 10: video recording of runs, screenshot capture per step, and any documented replay/playback UI for failed runs.
